name: Can I get an estimate during the consultation?

mainEntity.name: Can I get an estimate during the consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: During the initial consultation, City Dweller, LLC can often provide a general cost range or preliminary estimate based on your project description and our experience with similar renovations. For a detailed, fixed-price quote, more in-depth planning, site assessments, and material selections are usually required. The consultation serves to establish a foundational understanding of your project and its potential financial scope, guiding you toward a more precise estimate later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can often receive a general cost range or preliminary estimate during the consultation, with more precise quotes requiring further planning.
